title: CozyCraft
description: adds some cozy minecraft mods that will make the server with ur friends live longer
body:
🪴 CozyCraft

CozyCraft is a light, comfort-focused modpack that enhances the core Minecraft experience without changing what makes it great.
It keeps the classic vanilla feel but adds small touches of life, warmth, and detail — perfect for players who love building, decorating, and exploring at their own pace.

This pack introduces improved visuals, new decoration blocks, and subtle quality-of-life tweaks that make survival smoother and more enjoyable. Every addition is chosen to blend naturally with vanilla gameplay, creating a world that feels familiar yet refreshingly alive.

No complicated tech trees, no grindy progression — just a cozy, relaxing Minecraft experience for you and your friends.
Whether you’re designing your perfect cabin, creating a peaceful village, or simply enjoying the scenery, CozyCraft makes every block feel a little more special.

Simple. Beautiful. Vanilla — but better.
